segments.en: Come clean.

segments.en: He needs to confess.

segments.en: Confess, right.

segments.en: Right, it might not be true.

segments.en: It wasn't necessary.
segments.zh: 没有必要。

segments.en: Alright, so maybe it was your annual vacation day but you came into work anyway.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以也许这是你的年度假期，但无论如何你都上班了。

segments.en: Or maybe it was a holiday and I came to work anyways.
segments.zh: 或者也许这是一个假期，我还是来上班的。

segments.en: So, the plan was not for you to come to work.
segments.zh: 所以，计划不是让你来工作。

segments.en: Right, so in this case we're saying it wasn't necessary.
segments.zh: 对，所以在这种情况下，我们说这不是必要的。

segments.en: Or it wasn't planned.
segments.zh: 或者没有计划。

segments.en: Or planned.
segments.zh: 或计划。

segments.en: Now let's look at it the other way, when you shouldn't.
segments.zh: 现在让我们以另一种方式看待它，当你不应该的时候。

segments.en: Okay, Marco I wasn't supposed to tell you this but...
segments.zh: 好吧，马可我不应该告诉你这个，但是...

segments.en: Okay, so now in this case you shouldn't be telling me this, you shouldn't tell me the secret, but you're going to anyways.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以现在在这种情况下，你不应该告诉我这个，你不应该告诉我这个秘密，但无论如何你都会去。

segments.en: Yes, off air.
segments.zh: 是的，停机。

segments.en: So, I wasn't supposed to, in this case it means I shouldn't.
segments.zh: 所以，我不应该这样做，在这种情况下，这意味着我不应该这样做。

segments.en: Alright, some really great language here, now I think it would help us to hear it one more time in the dialogue.
segments.zh: 好吧，这里有一些非常棒的语言，现在我认为它会帮助我们在对话中再听到一次。

segments.en: Veronica, Veronica, Veronica, are you okay?
segments.zh: 维罗妮卡、维罗妮卡、维罗妮卡，你还好吗？

segments.en: Steven, what's going on?
segments.zh: 史蒂文，这是怎么回事？

segments.en: Who were those guys?
segments.zh: 那些人是谁？

segments.en: I didn't know you have a gun.
segments.zh: 我不知道你有枪。

segments.en: What's going on?
segments.zh: 怎么回事？

segments.en: I will come clean as soon as we get to safety, okay?
segments.zh: 我们一到安全区，我会尽快清理的，好吗？

segments.en: For now you have to trust me, please, I would never do anything to hurt you.
segments.zh: 现在你必须相信我，我永远不会做任何伤害你的事情。

segments.en: Steven, I...
segments.zh: 史蒂文，我...

segments.en: Okay, run!
segments.zh: 好吧，跑！

segments.en: I haven't been completely honest with you, Veronica, I'm sorry.
segments.zh: 我对你不是完全诚实的，维罗妮卡，对不起。

segments.en: I'm not a fireman, I'm not even from the United States.
segments.zh: 我不是消防员，我什至不是来自美国。

segments.en: I'm a spy for the Indian government.
segments.zh: 我是印度政府的间谍。

segments.en: What?
segments.zh: 什么？

segments.en: Why didn't you tell me before?
segments.zh: 你之前为什么不告诉我？

segments.en: What are you doing here?
segments.zh: 你来这里做什么？

segments.en: When I was a young boy, I used to play cricket with my father back in my hometown of Hyderabad.
segments.zh: 小时候，我常在家乡海得拉巴和父亲打板球。

segments.en: It was a peaceful town, and my father was a renowned chemist.
segments.zh: 那是个宁静的小镇，父亲是位知名的化学家。

segments.en: One day he was approached by members of the CIA, claiming that my father had made the discovery of the Millennium in his small lab back at the university, where he taught biochemistry.
segments.zh: 有一天，中央情报局成员与他联系，声称我父亲在他在大学的小实验室中发现了千年，在那里他教授生物化学。

segments.en: When I saw him again, I vowed to discover the whereabouts of my father, and consequently joined the Indian Intelligence Bureau.
segments.zh: 当我再次见到他时，我发誓要发现我父亲的下落，因此加入了印度情报局。

segments.en: What does that have to do with those men shooting at us? And most importantly, why did you lie to me?
segments.zh: 这跟那些朝我们开枪的人有什么关系？更重要的是，你为什么骗我？

segments.en: I'm sorry. I wasn't supposed to meet you, I wasn't supposed to fall in love with you.
segments.zh: 对不起。 我不应该见到你，我不应该爱上你。

segments.en: But you have to believe me when I tell you that what I feel for you is real.
segments.zh: 但请你相信，我对你的感情是真的。

segments.en: I can't believe this.
segments.zh: 我无法相信这一点。

segments.en: Why are all these things happening to me? I can't take it anymore.
segments.zh: 为什么这些事都发生在我身上？我再也受不了了。

segments.en: Let me out of the car.
segments.zh: 让我下车。

segments.en: Veronica, wait!
segments.zh: 维罗妮卡，等等！

segments.en: Okay, great.
segments.zh: 好，太好了。

segments.en: So now we're getting close to the end of this series. So what's gonna happen?
segments.zh: 所以现在我们接近这个系列的结尾。 那么会发生什么？

segments.en: Maybe Veronica is also a spy.
segments.zh: 也许维罗妮卡也是间谍。

segments.en: Oh my God, I don't think I can handle that.
segments.zh: 哦，我的上帝，我认为我无法处理这个问题。

segments.en: Alright, so we really need your suggestions, we need your ideas. We want to know how you think the series ends or how you would want it to end.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以我们真的需要你的建议，我们需要你的想法。 我们想知道您认为该系列的结束方式或您希望它如何结束。

segments.en: Do you want it to be a happy ending?
segments.zh: 你希望它是一个幸福的结局吗？

segments.en: Or a tragedy?
segments.zh: 还是悲剧？

segments.en: Or maybe action-filled ending?
segments.zh: 或者也许是充满动作的结局？

segments.en: Alright, well, we've got two lessons left in this series, so visit our website at EnglishPod.com and leave your suggestions.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们在本系列中还剩下两个课程，请访问我们的网站 englishpod.com 并留下您的建议。

segments.en: Alright guys, we'll see you guys there and until next time.
segments.zh: 好吧，伙计们，我们会在那里见到你们，直到下一次。

segments.en: Goodbye!
segments.zh: 再见！

segments.en: Bye!
segments.zh: 再见！
